[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] '''Yettaw''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] official in charge of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Misnor]]. Yettaw refused to restrict or ban the hunting of the native [[Chiilak/Legends|chiilaks]] because of the immense revenue generated by sales of chiilak-furred garments.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy" />
